meta.title: mcpemails · Give your AI agent an inbox.
meta.description: Connect your email accounts to Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client. Read, send, search, and reply to email via the Model Context Protocol.

hero.lead: Connect Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, or any IMAP inbox once. Paste one MCP endpoint URL into claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible agent. OAuth clients connect in a click, no API key setup. Your agent reads, searches, and sends mail live, and the mail it reads is never stored.

features.sub: The decisions that shaped the product. If any of them stop being true, that's a bug worth filing.

0.h: Six core tools. The essentials, covered.
0.p: The six core calls cover the everyday work — inbox_list, email_list, email_read, email_search, email_send, email_reply — and more advanced tools (folders, drafts, scheduling) are there when you need them. Paste the MCP endpoint URL into claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible agent.

1.h: Email is fetched live. Never stored.
1.p: Every tool call hits your provider in real time: Gmail API, Fastmail JMAP, or IMAP. Message bodies, subjects, and attachments go to the agent and are discarded immediately. We persist one thing per inbox, an encrypted token or app password, so we can make the next call. The one exception is a message you schedule to send later: we hold it until the send time, then keep a record for your history.

2.p: When your agent calls email_send or email_reply, the message is dispatched via the Gmail API, Fastmail JMAP, or your own SMTP server. Your domain reputation and deliverability stay entirely in your hands. We never relay mail from our own domain.

3.h: Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail & any IMAP inbox.
3.p: OAuth 2.0 for Gmail; app-specific passwords for Fastmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, and Yandex; a generic IMAP / SMTP connector for everything else. Connect multiple inboxes, label them by use case (work-gmail, ops-fastmail, support-imap), and scope each API key to the inboxes you want that agent to reach.

4.h: OAuth 2.0 for agents. One click to revoke.
4.p: Any MCP client that supports OAuth (claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and others) connects automatically via authorization code + PKCE. No API key setup. API keys are there for clients without OAuth and for scripted access. Either way, you revoke any connection from the dashboard in one click.

5.p: OAuth tokens and app passwords are AES-256-GCM encrypted before being written to the database. Decryption happens only inside an isolated Edge Function at call time. The encryption key is stored as an environment secret, separate from the database.

howItWorks.title: You're the user. We're the pipe.
howItWorks.sub: Three steps from sign-up to your agent reading and sending mail.

0.p: Sign in and click Connect Inbox. Choose Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, or any IMAP inbox, then complete OAuth or paste an app password. Credentials are encrypted; the mail your agent reads is never stored.

1.h: Paste the URL: OAuth or API key
1.p: For an MCP client that supports OAuth 2.0 (claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and others), paste https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp, click Connect, and authorize. No key needed. For clients without OAuth (Cline, JetBrains, custom scripts), generate a scoped API key in the dashboard instead.

2.p: The agent calls tools like email_search() or email_reply(). MCPEmails fetches live from your provider and returns the result. Nothing is cached between calls.

tools.0: Discover all connected inboxes and their IDs. Call this first, no UUID copy-pasting from the dashboard.
tools.1: List recent messages with sender, subject, date, and snippet, up to 100 per call.
tools.2: Fetch a single message by ID. Returns parsed plain-text and sanitized HTML body, plus attachment metadata.
tools.3: Provider-native search: Gmail query syntax, Fastmail JMAP, or IMAP SEARCH. Returns up to 100 matches.
tools.4: Send a new message via the connected account. Dispatched through Gmail API, Fastmail JMAP, or SMTP: your domain, your deliverability.
tools.5: Reply in-thread with correct Message-ID and References headers. Works across Gmail, Fastmail, and any IMAP inbox.

quote.text: I wanted my agents to work my inbox, but every option meant handing a third party a copy of my email. So I built the pipe I wished existed: connect once, your inbox is fetched live and never stored, and you can cut off any agent in a click. That's the product I trust with my own inbox.
